races.verdict: THEY'RE CHANCERS has made a bright start to his career, winning his sole outing in bumpers and beaten only by a fellow well-bred type at Kelso on his hurdling debut. He is fancied to open his hurdles account with improvement to come, Ar Ais Aris next on the list ahead of Baron du Brizais . THEY'RE CHANCERS (IRE) AR AIS ARIS (IRE) BARON DU BRIZAIS (FR)

races.display_title: Crown & Thistle Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: DOUBLY BLESSED shaped well when beaten only by a good prospect in a Kelso bumper and he could be capable of going one better as he makes his hurdling/stable debut. Junior des Mottes made a positive start for this yard when third in the same race and is entitled to finish a bit closer on revised terms, while King Berry is an interesting contender stepping up in trip. COVENTRY (IRE) JUNIOR DES MOTTES (FR) KING BERRY (IRE)
